answer: Stop sybils with a bridge lagoon spiral: an agent bonds one lagoon dock. Each cycle it walks the bridge and twists one spiral auger into the bed; verifiers match its torque to the dock chart, voiding a copied twist, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 lagoons at 18x: one auger twists once into one bed, its torque set by that silt, untwistable for a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents twist once, keep rights.
